title: Encoding Length Bound for Lists
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a type, let $f$ assign a finite bit string to each element of $\alpha$, and let $b$ be a natural number. If every element $a$ of a finite list $as$ satisfies $|f(a)|\le b$, then the length of the list encoding is at most $|as|(b+1)+1$.
hypotheses_covered: For every $a\in as$, the length of $f(a)$ is at most $b$
